## How I checked it

- [ ] `uv run ruff check src tests`

- [ ] Site changes: `npm run lint` and `npm run build` in `site/`

## Checklist

- [ ] No message text, images or personal data are stored or logged by this change
- [ ] No detection rule patterns, model weights or real children's messages are included
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, databases or personal info (real names, emails, local paths) in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior changed (`README.md`, `docs/`)
